findings: TC-AUTH-001: the test authenticates as warehouse_operator, but the requirement permits approval only to sales_manager; the expected successful approval is inconsistent with the requirement.
TC-AUTH-001: the requirement does not specify the unauthorized response, so a replacement expected result cannot be safely invented.

requirements.text: Only sales_manager may approve an order through POST /api/v1/orders/{order_id}/approve; a successful approval returns HTTP 200 with status APPROVED.

test_cases.title: Warehouse operator approves an order

steps.expected_result: HTTP 200 is returned with status APPROVED.

test_cases.expected_outcome: HTTP 200 is returned with status APPROVED.
